Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrows fire/aim/set facing; movement+fire combine in one step; tears auto-fire in facing direction. E places/uses bomb; Space activates pedestal/item; Q uses/drops card (no confirmed effect). Fine movement: 0.1s≈40px, 0.2s≈80px, 0.3s≈120px, 0.5s≈200px. Door/hatch/trapdoor transitions require centered overlap PLUS 2-3 repeated presses; standing inside the alcove and pressing again often helps; a single press almost never works. Player sprite renders inconsistently (white/pink blob, TV-head, gray face) and can resemble enemies—confirm identity by moving.

HUD/PICKUPS (observed): hearts go hollow after damage; blue/soul hearts from blue pill; counters for coins, keys, bombs; item/card slots; minimap shows red enemy dots. All-hollow hearts observed repeatedly; in one case it preceded a run end, but hollow-heart runs remained controllable at other times—treat as critical/possibly terminal. Pickups on touch, but coins need exact overlap. Poop sometimes hides/releases items (TECH X banner observed); some poop inert. Chests may damage once on contact; some vanish or act mimic-like.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear with red X impact; radius ~140-150px; placement inconsistent (short sometimes, feet when near walls). Blocks line of fire; point-blank unsafe. Damages fats, gray faces, shelled, flies, clustered spiders. Does NOT crack rock rings or TNT barrels; left-wall boss statue showed no damage feedback; embedded eye-faces survived blasts (likely invulnerable, uncertain). y-offset >~70px misses.

ENEMIES: winged flies are tanky, chase/fire tears downward, and often guard hatches—kill before transitioning. Fat pink/white/gray-faced enemies are very tanky, enrage with red aura/red tint, chase relentlessly, and contact drains hearts fast; they need many hits and die in red splatter. Shelled white-faced enemies emerge from spiky rock piles, fire blue orbs/tears, and leave damaging green spiky clouds. Bomb-bugs are burst-immune (tears passed through without killing visible) and explode on contact, chaining TNT barrels. Black spiders cluster and are deadly at close range. Green spiky clouds, poison puddles, brazier flames, and enemy orbs damage. Gilded sack in boss room fires teardrops (possible mimic). Blue splatter marks enemy death.

NAVIGATION (observed): Tutorial room ('BASEMENT I'): top hatch ↔ rock room; bottom hatch ↔ brazier room; right-wall dark riveted door ↔ dark stone room. Rock room: left keyhole/shop door opened without a key previously; shop sells bomb 5¢, card 15¢; bottom hatch ↔ tutorial; top hatch ↔ TNT room (transition succeeded after clearing enemies and standing in alcove with extra presses). TNT room: two isolated TNT barrels mid-room (~x585 and ~x790) flank a safe central gap; left wall has TNT cluster plus gray stone crates and a reddish barrel; a bomb-bug patrols the left side; top hatch ↔ boss room (needs centered alcove + repeated presses); bottom trapdoor ↔ rock room. Boss room: central rock pile blocks fire lanes (~x560-700, y290-410); dark left-wall statue with red glow/eyes (undamaged by attacks); embedded eye-faces in right rock wall; gilded sack with a fly on top at right that shoots teardrops; card on the floor; bottom trapdoor ↔ TNT room; no other exit observed. Brazier room: four damaging corner braziers; central rock ring/chest (access unresolved—bomb and TECH X failed); poison poop; bottom-center golden gate ↔ dark two-poop chamber; top alcove ↔ tutorial; left corridor bypasses the ring. Dark stone room: left exit ↔ tutorial; red-barred chests on top wall; central spiked chest; two floor holes (probably pits); black spiders.

FAILED/CAUTION: attacking the boss-room statue; attacking embedded eye-faces; shooting bomb-bugs; assuming chests won't hurt; lingering in green/poison clouds or brazier fire; shooting into nearby walls/rocks; assuming one press opens hatches/trapdoors (need centered overlap + repeats); assuming coins collect on near-touch; assuming all poop yields loot; assuming Q card works. Item banners (TECH X; MATCH STICK—'Tastes like burning'; 2 OF SPADES—'Item multiplier') can replace the active item; after Match Stick, ring bursts were not visibly firing (unconfirmed). Firing while moving drifts aim; small offsets cause misses. In the boss room, fighting two enraged fats at close range drained hearts to near-death—kiting around the central rock pile and maintaining 100px+ row-aligned fire is the safer tactic; the bottom trapdoor is the reliable escape when critical.

UNRESOLVED: how to progress past the boss/TNT/statue loop or what damages the statue; whether eye-faces are invulnerable or high-HP; what the gilded sack/creature is; whether it is a boss trigger or mimic; whether red-barred/spiked dark-room chests open and what the floor holes do; card effects (Q unclear; 2 of Spades unknown); meaning of all-hollow hearts; how to reach the brazier-room rock-ring chest (bomb placement/method uncertain); whether the shop keyhole door truly needs no key; whether room clearing (rather than alcove position) enables hatch transitions; whether enemy contact during a transition attempt can cancel it.
